part.text:
Fixed. Summary:

**Root cause** (src/component.js:348): the `value` prop is only applied when `newProps.value !== dom.value`. In Chrome, `progress.value` returns `0` when the `value` attribute is absent, so `value={0}` matched the default DOM state and was never applied — leaving the attribute unset.

**Fix**: also compare against `oldProps.value`, so the value is applied whenever it differs from the previous props (or the DOM). This keeps the "always diff value against DOM" behavior (issue #1324 test) and avoids redundant same-value property writes on re-renders (cursor-preservation).
